description: This Dart file defines common UI widgets and theme configurations for a Flutter application, including an app-wide theme, a scaffold wrapper, and an empty state component.

classes.name: OceanTheme
classes.description: Provides app-wide theme data, color constants, and styling methods to ensure consistent visual design.

classes.name: OceanScaffold
classes.description: A reusable scaffold widget applying a gradient background, standard app bar, and optional floating action button.

classes.name: EmptyState
classes.description: A widget that displays an icon, title, subtitle, and optional action when a section has no data.

methods.name: themeData
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured with Ocean's color palette and style Customizations.

methods.name: softGradientBackground
methods.description: Provides a BoxDecoration with a linear gradient used as the background for OceanScaffold.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for OceanScaffold, applying the gradient background, AppBar, and body content.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for EmptyState, rendering icon, title, subtitle, and optional action.
